repository.description: Absolute path to the working tree the review is run in.

pr_number.description: The pull request number, where there is one.

base_ref.description: The ref the change is measured against.

claims.description: What the change says it does, in the author's words, unparaphrased. A review checks these; it does not restate them.

diff_stat.description: Size as git reports it. A fact about the review's cost, not about its quality.

out_of_scope.description: What this review is explicitly NOT about.
